name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 7 – Am 11
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 7a. Calls for the EU budget to include a programme protecting productive sectors and jobs, targeting those countries which, throughout the integration process, were the most disadvantaged by common policies, the Economic and Monetary Union and the single currency;
